messages:
lina_cs: Heads-up team: GreenfieldAgri wants to pilot a custom model 'CropSense-13b-int8' in a Private deployment (EU region only). Key constraints: data residency in eu-west-1, strict safety gating for agronomic pesticide recommendations, and no external webhook callbacks until we sign off on safety evals. Theyre asking for a 2-week pilot starting next month. Any immediate blockers? :calendar:

jess_onboard: Do they have the model as GGUF or HF? Also need to know vocab/tokenizer format (sentencepiece vs byte-level). INT8 quantization is okay but we'll run a compile pass to validate custom ops.

lina_cs: They uploaded a tarball with GGUF and tokenizer.json (sentencepiece). Sequence length target: 2048.

jess_onboard: 2048 + int8 might need memory tuning. Action: I'll attempt a local compile on eu-west GPUs and run a small canary with egress disabled. ETA 48 hours. I'll post compile results.

marco_research: Safety note: pesticide dosing and application location are high-risk outputs. Suggest test battery: 1) focused red-team prompts (40 variants), 2) precision/recall on a labeled pesticide QA set (we have 250 examples), 3) counterfactual robustness (change units/locations). I'll create the eval run and a pass/fail rubric.

marco_research: I'll seed the eval run under: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/greenfield-cropsense-13b

jess_onboard: Draft private deployment snippet for infra: 
```
model: cropsense-13b-int8
quant: int8
max_seq: 2048
region: eu-west-1
network:
  egress: disabled
  allowed_ips: []
kms: customer-kms-eu-west-1
callbacks: disabled_until_safe=true
```
I'll attach logs and the compile artifact when ready.

legal-bot: Note: need to include a pilot clause that disclaims regulatory/agronomic liability and restricts distribution. Legal review requested.

priya_renewals: FYI, GreenfieldAgri's reserved capacity renewal is in ~45 days. Pilot timeline affects renewal negotiation leverage. Recommend we lock a success metric set now: p95 latency <= 350ms, safety-failures per 1000 prompts < 1, and model availability 99.5% during pilot. I'll prepare a backup pilot offer if timelines slip.

lina_cs: Agreed. Metrics to capture: p95 latency, safety regression count per eval run, FP/FN on pesticide QA set, and any user-reported unsafe outputs.

jess_onboard: Also flag for integrations: they want a Slack alert to their internal agronomy channel for pilot failures. That will be blocked until callbacks are enabled; instead we can stream alerts to CS.

ops-bot: Private deploy checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/private-deploy-checklist and EU KMS onboarding: https://confluence.redwood.ai/kms-eu-guide

lina_cs: Action items:
- jess_onboard: compile & initial canary (owner)
- marco_research: create eval run + labeled QA set analysis (owner)
- priya_renewals: draft renewal contingency + success metrics (owner)
- lina_cs: schedule customer sync with GreenfieldAgri and legal (owner)

quote_from_mira_customer: "We need to ensure our agronomists can't get dosing that violates local regs. We'll wait for your safety pass before wider access."

jess_onboard: Targeting first canary by 1729625000 (Mon). Will post results and invite CS/research/legal to the canary channel.

lina_cs: Thanks all 10 Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
